title: Kaleido Star

ai_content.intro: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل Kaleido Star (2003) مترجم بجودة عالية على توميتو.
ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل كاليدو ستار مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: Sora, a young girl from Japan, comes to America in search of her dream. She wants, with all her heart, to be a member of the famous Kaleido Stage, a combination of musicals, acrobatics and magical effects. With the help of her friends, she struggles to make this dream come true.
